About us

Student-run. Detail-driven.

Truman Hill and Colt Aja are students at Regents School of Austin who are committed to providing reliable and professional power washing services.

As student-athletes, we bring discipline, attention to detail, and a strong work ethic to every job. Our goal is to help homeowners safely maintain and protect their property through quality, dependable service.

We treat every property the way we'd want ours treated — no shortcuts, no rushed jobs, no leaving until it's right. Between school and sports, we've learned how to show up on time and follow through, and we bring that same mindset to every driveway, deck, and trash can we clean. When you book with us, you're supporting two local students building something real, one job at a time.

  • ✓ Reliable, on-time service
  • ✓ Upfront pricing, no surprise fees
  • ✓ Careful, detail-oriented crew
  • ✓ Flexible scheduling
